title: Senior Sales Manager - Media (m/w/d)
description:
Who We Are

Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers-no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve’s solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States’ top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world’s top demand-side platforms. Learn more at verve.com .

Der fehlende Wirkungsnachweis ist das größte Problem im stationären Handel für Werbungtreibende. Obwohl Marken Millionen in Werbung am Point of Sale investieren, können sie nicht belegen, ob daraus
Käufe wurden. Verve Retail Media (VRM) löst dieses Problem. Wir vermarkten und betreiben digitale Werbe-Screens in mehreren tausend LEH-, Drogerie- und Convenience-Standorten und verbinden sie mit digitalen
Coupons, Retargeting im CTV und anderen Offsite-Kanälen. Marken buchen bei uns keine isolierten Werbeformate, sondern 360-Grad-Kampagnen, die zu Hause starten und bis zum Einkaufsregal reichen -eine Closed-Loop-Messung auf Basis realer Kassendaten.

VRM ist die eigenständige Retail Media Unit der börsennotierten Verve Group SE. Wir arbeiten wie ein schnell skalierendes Startup mit AI-First-Strategie über alle Funktionen und mit Zugriff auf die Infrastruktur eines internationalen AdTech-Unternehmens mit über einer Billionen ausgelieferter Werbeimpressionen pro Jahr. Zur Verve Retail Media gehört seit kurzem der Couponing- und Cashback-Spezialist acardo.

Die Rolle in einem Satz
Du trägst eine Hunter-Mentalität in dir und gewinnst neue Umsätze bei FMCG-Marken, indem du integrierte Shopper Activation Kampagnen verkaufst: d.h. coupon-getriebene Conversion und messbarer Sales Lift, idealerweise erweitert um Screen-Präsenz im Markt.

Was du verkaufst

• Ein kombiniertes Produkt aus digitaler Sichtbarkeit im Markt Screens an Eingang, Fläche, Kasse), Aktivierung am Point of Sale (über Coupons) und Closed-Loop-Messung auf Basis realer Kassendaten (anstatt isolierter Werbeflächen oder losgelöster Coupons)

• Kampagnen, die drei Logiken beim Kunden verbinden: Markenreichweite, Abverkauf und Kategorie-Relevanz

• 360Grad-Aktivierung, die über den Markt hinausgeht: (Re)Targeting im CTV und weiteren Offsite-Kanälen als Verlängerung der In-Store-Kampagne

• Konkrete Beweispunkte aus Pilotprojekten: z.B. 9% Uplift auf Store-Ebene, 20% in ausgewählten Kategorien

An wen du verkaufst

• Direkt an FMCG-Marken

• Die Ansprechpartner kommen meist aus Brand und Media (-Planung und -Einkauf) und verwalten drei Budgettöpfe mit unterschiedlichen Zielen, Freigabelogiken und Erfolgsmetriken

Deine Aufgaben

• Eigene Pipeline aufbauen, entwickeln, priorisieren und mit belastbarem Forecast führen

• Neukunden und Stakeholder (horizontal und vertikal) gewinnen und Kunden zu wiederkehrenden Partnern entwickeln

• Den kompletten Sales-Zyklus verantworten: Erstansprache, Qualifizierung, Bedarfsanalyse, Angebot, Verhandlung und Abschluss. Mit Abschluss erfolgt die Übergabe ans AdOps Team

• Kundenziele in Media- und Aktivierungskonzepte übersetzen: Touchpoints, Reichweiten, Zielgruppen, Mechaniken Cashback, Gratis-Testen, Kategorie-Trigger), Messansatz

• Sales-Lift-Daten und Pilotergebnisse als Beweispunkte im Pitch einsetzen, um aus ersten Testbudgets hohe wiederkehrende Volumina zu machen

• VRM gegenüber konkurrierenden Retail-Media-Formaten klar differenzieren

• Feedback aus dem Markt in Produkt, Pitchmaterial und Go-to-Market zurückspielen

So ist die Rolle aufgesetzt

• Du bist ein Individual Contributor ohne Personalverantwortung

• Du berichtest direkt an die CSO

• Du verkaufst eigenständig, aber nicht allein: Media Planning entwickelt das Kampagnen-Setup, Ad Operations steuert die Ausli

title: Technical Project Manager (f/m/d)
description:
About IONOS

At IONOS, we don't just manage servers - we shape the digital future for more than 6.2 million customers worldwide with our solutions. As Europe's leading hosting provider and a pioneer in independent cloud solutions, we are building next-generation infrastructure - from sovereign cloud architectures and high-performance GPU clusters to integrated AI automation tools.

What drives us is digital sovereignty for Europe and real impact for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) as well as large enterprises. We work in agile teams, rely on transparent structures, and believe that excellence and innovation only emerge through true team spirit.

Ready for your next step? Become part of IONOS and grow with us.

Do you love bringing structure to complex topics, making projects transparent, and driving real impact from day one? Join our team at our Karlsruhe or Berlin offices. In this role within the CPO PMO, you will work closely with the CTO PMO and cross-functional teams to establish robust project management practices across the company, making sure projects, requirements, priorities and resources are clearly visible and manageable.

Tasks

• Manage medium-sized programs and complex projects across the entire lifecycle, leading critical initiatives across various business areas, primarily at the interface between Product Management and Software Development.

• Structure projects by status, effort, risks, dependencies, business value and resource needs, and support sponsors and idea owners with strategic plans

• Help define and establish our project management methodology, prioritization logic (business value, effort, urgency, capacity) and refined change management process

• Plan resources and capacity strategically, and help resolve resource conflicts across departments

• Keep delivery status (time, budget, quality) fully transparent, escalate risks early, and report clearly to executive management and stakeholders

• Align stakeholders with differing goals across Software Development, IT, BI, Commercial Management, Sales, Finance, Networks and Customer Care

• Drive AI automation of PMO workflows with Claude and n8n, and mentor and coach other Project Managers in advanced planning and risk management

Qualifications

• Degree or equivalent qualification in Business Informatics, Computer Science, Business Administration, Project Management or a related field

• Solid, demonstrated experience in project management within a technical environment (IT project management or digital delivery), including running several complex initiatives in parallel

• Strong knowledge of traditional and agile frameworks (e.g., PRINCE2, PMP, Scrum, SAFe) combined with a strong IT affinity to bridge business and technology-including proficiency in Jira and Confluence, and ideally first to intermediate experience using Claude and n8n for workflow automation.

• Proven ability to structure complex, ambiguous topics into actionable next steps, with strong conflict resolution skills, a pragmatic, independent working style and confident communication at all stakeholder levels

• Strong, professional working proficiency in German and English (written and spoken).

Benefits

• Hybrid working model, and flexible working hours through trust-based working hours.

• At some locations a subsidized canteen and various free drinks.

• Modern office space with very good transport connections.

• Various employee discounts for activities and products.

• Employee events such as summer and winter parties, as well as workshops.

• Numerous training and development opportunities.

• Various health offers, such as sports and health courses.

 
Application Note

We value diversity and welcome all applications - regardless of, for example, gender, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion, disability, age as well as sexual orientation and identity, physical characteristics, marital status or any other irrelevant factor subject to applicable law.

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
Aven Hospitality is an innovative technology provider powered by SynXis®, the leading global hospitality commerce and distribution platform. We empower hoteliers around the world to exceed expectations, solve daily challenges, and stay ahead of the competition.
With our comprehensive portfolio of solutions, hoteliers can manage distribution, retailing, payments, operations, and more. Providing hoteliers the tools to maximize revenue, improve operational efficiency, and deliver personalized guest experiences that drive satisfaction.
Our tools are built to seamlessly integrate with each hotelier’s unique strategy, elevating guest satisfaction and creating meaningful connections.
We are pioneering AI in hospitality technology to unlock new opportunities, drive efficiency, and personalize the guest experience. By prioritizing stability, scalability, and data-driven insights, we equip hoteliers to adapt and thrive in an ever-changing landscape, ready for whatever comes next..
Product Marketing Manager

As a Product Marketing Manager, you will define and lead product marketing strategy across a portfolio of high-growth solutions with a strong emphasis on AI-enabled capabilities and payments, and other strategic product areas shaping the future of hospitality technology. Your work will drive adoption, competitive differentiation, and measurable business outcomes. You are the strategic connective tissue between product, marketing, sales, and customer success-guiding GTM execution, shaping product narratives, and ensuring that business priorities are translated into market impact.

While this role requires close partnership with product, sales, and customer success, its highest impact comes from shaping market strategy, building differentiated narratives, orchestrating launches, and equipping teams to connect product innovation to customer and business outcomes. You will help translate complex and emerging solutions, especially in AI-enabled experiences, payments, commerce, and hospitality technology into clear market value.

This role will play a key part in bringing emerging and high-priority solutions to market, including AI-driven guest and operational experiences, payments, digital commerce, and other product areas that support our broader commercial strategy. Innowacja przez różnorodność

Niezależnie od Twojego doświadczenia, pochodzenia, tożsamości płciowej czy indywidualnych okoliczności, to Twoja osobowość nas najbardziej interesuje. Chainguard is seeking a Security Analyst (Assurance and Automation) to strengthen how we support customer trust and scale security work through automation. This role combines security assurance operations with the maintenance and governance of AI agents used by the Governance and Trust function.

You will help keep the security information we share with customers accurate, current, and easy to access. You will also maintain the AI agents that support governance and trust workflows-auditing their behavior, updating their knowledge, and helping prevent drift as our business and security practices evolve.

This is an analyst role for someone who is detail-oriented, comfortable working with security and customer-facing content, and energized by the practical application of AI in security operations.

Security assurance and customer trust

•
Maintain and improve the internal corpus of responses used for customer security questionnaires.

Keep Trust Center content and public go-to-market security materials accurate and up to date.

•
Maintain customer-facing security artifacts used during the sales process.

•
Ensure security documentation reflects current products, practices, and architecture.

•
Establish repeatable processes for reviewing, updating, versioning, and publishing assurance content.

•
Identify gaps, inconsistencies, and outdated information before materials are shared with customers.

Automation and AI governance

•
Maintain and update AI agents used by the Governance and Trust function.

•
Audit agents regularly for accuracy, quality, reliability, and drift.

•
Refresh agent instructions, prompts, reference content, and other supporting information as requirements change.

•
Help define practical standards for maintaining AI-enabled workflows in a security and governance context.

•
Document agent behavior, changes, known limitations, and review outcomes.

•
Partner with stakeholders to identify opportunities to improve the reliability and usefulness of AI-assisted security work.

What you’ll bring

•
Experience in security assurance, security operations, GRC, customer trust, or a related security function.

•
Experience maintaining security questionnaires, Trust Center content, data flow diagrams, audit evidence, or other customer-facing security artifacts.

•
Strong attention to detail and a disciplined approach to documentation, version control, and quality review.

•
Comfort working with AI models or AI-enabled workflows, including maintaining models or agents rather than building models from scratch.

•
Familiarity with prompt engineering, prompt evaluation, or similar techniques for improving AI system performance.

•

title: Senior Director, Product and Technology
description:
Senior Director, Product and Technology

Location: Remote,

Application Submission Deadline: November 1, 2026

About Us

Propel America addresses a broken workforce system that fails both young adults and healthcare employers, sidelining talented individuals from entering healthcare careers and contributing to critical workforce shortages that threaten community health. Propel’s work centers on bridging this gap by creating alternative, debt-free career pathways into healthcare for young adults ages 18-26, particularly those from underrepresented and low-income backgrounds, while helping employers access the trained, diverse talent they urgently need. Today, over 13 million young adults in the U.S. are either not in school, not working, or stuck in low-wage jobs with little room for growth. Traditional college remains financially and logistically out of reach for many, especially young people from low-income communities, forcing them into a false choice: sacrifice income to pursue an expensive degree or remain in low-wage work without upward mobility. At the same time, systemic barriers, such as limited exposure to healthcare roles, low visibility of alternative pathways, and a lack of representative mentors, prevent many high school graduates from entering the healthcare field.

Meanwhile, healthcare employers face compounding workforce shortages. The Bureau of Labor Statistics projects a 13% growth in healthcare jobs from 2021 to 2031, translating to nearly 2 million openings annually. Many of these are middle-skill roles, which represent over half the U.S. labor market but remain unfilled due to a lack of training infrastructure. Employers often contend with high turnover in entry-level positions yet underinvest in structured career advancement pathways or innovative strategies to retain talent.

Propel America aims to solve both sides of the equation, by equipping young adults with the skills and support to launch healthcare careers and by helping employers build stronger, more diverse, and more stable workforces. In our portfolio, we offer a suite of Propel Paths and Propel Products to place young adults in critical talent gaps in healthcare

To learn more about Propel America , please visit .

The Opportunity

Propel America is undergoing an exciting phase of growth and technological transformation, marked by the development of our signature Fellow Portal and the integration of cutting-edge AI technologies into our program delivery. To lead this effort, we are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Director, Product and Technology.

This role sits within our newly formed Solutions Team and reports directly to the Vice President of Solutions.

The Director will serve as our core technology lead, managing the technical implementation of our product roadmap, maintaining the integrity of our overall technology stack, and directly supervising our technical staff (Salesforce Administrator and Junior Product Developer).

Key Responsibilities

The ideal candidate is a product developer who can set a vision and design the technology roadmap while also architecting integrations, managing developers and salesforce administration as well as overseeing outsourced Managed Service Providers (MSPs). The Direct will act as the critical link between Propel’s strategic vision and our day-to-day software execution, ensuring that our infrastructure is secure, scalable, and built to support our fellows' journey

description:
Job Title: In-Home Physician Per Diem - Terre Haute
Job Location: Work at Home, Indiana, United States
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Part time
Job Seniority Level:
We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD
Per diem employees qualify for:

• Hourly base rate, plus additional incentive structure (i.e., per visit completed, other incentives may apply)

• Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

• Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

• Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

• Multi-state licenses (preferred)

description:

Remote · Quarterly team gatherings in one of our global offices · Competitive salary
About the Role
At OrderYOYO , payments sit at the heart of everything we do. Every order placed, every restaurant paid, and every dispute resolved runs through the systems this team owns and operates.
We're looking for a Lead Software Engineer - Payments to own the next stage of our payments platform's evolution - as a hands-on technical leader who can grow and manage a team of payments engineers, set the technical direction for a business-critical domain, and support our transition to a more scalable operating model across online ordering and in-store platforms (POS, Kiosk, and payment terminals).
You'll play a central role in shaping how OrderYOYO handles money - from authorisation and settlement to disputes and merchant invoicing - while building and developing the people who make that possible.
Role Mission
Lead the people, architecture, and delivery behind OrderYOYO 's payments platform - enabling KYC onboarding, deductions, settlement/payout timing, dispute flows, and merchant invoicing - while growing a high-performing engineering team and raising the bar on reliability, security, and engineering quality in one of our most business-critical domains.
Core Responsibilities
People Leadership & Team Development

• Lead, mentor, and grow a team of payments engineers - providing hands-on technical guidance, regular feedback, and clear paths for career development.

• Own hiring and team-building for the payments engineering function, partnering with recruiting to define role profiles, run interviews, and bring in strong talent.

Technical & Domain Ownership

• Set the technical direction and long-term architecture strategy for payment-domain services, including gateway integrations, payment intent/authorisation/capture/refund flows, payout orchestration, and reconciliation.

• Oversee marketplace capabilities: onboarding/KYC integration, merchant configuration, settlement instructions, deductions, and invoicing/merchant-statement alignment.

• Ensure robust “flow-of-funds” primitives across the team's systems - idempotency, ledgers/events, and audit trails that are fully supportable for finance and compliance.

• Own the strategy for PSP and partner integrations, with close attention to tri-party / sub-merchant implications where applicable.

• Oversee dispute/chargeback and fraud-handling touchpoints across internal workflows and PSP tooling, and drive collaboration with Ops on runbooks and escalation paths.

• Partner closely with Product, Legal/Compliance, Finance, and Support to convert requirements into safe, testable production behaviour.

• Raise engineering quality in a high-change domain: automated testing, safe rollouts/canaries, observability, and incident-response improvements, with accountability for outcomes across the team.

Must-Have Requirements

• Proven experience leading, mentoring, or people-managing a team of software engineers - including hiring, performance management, and career development.

• Strong backend engineering background in distributed systems - microservices, async processing, resilient APIs, and eventual consistency.

• Production experience with payment flows (auth/capture/refund, webhooks, reconciliation) and “money correctness” patterns such as idempotency keys, double-e

• Develop and execute strategic recruiting plans for AI/ML research and engineering roles, from hiring-manager intake through screen, interview loop management, offer strategy, and close.

• Build and sustain a high-trust network of ML researchers and applied scientists across subfields (LLM, RL, Generative AI) through consistent relationship-building, community presence, and non-traditional discovery loops (research publications, GitHub, conferences, open-source).

• Partner with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to map long-term AI/ML talent strategy and balance hiring priorities across research teams.

• Strengthen Lila's employer brand within the ML research and scientific community - representing our mission, culture, and technical work to candidates with strong options elsewhere.

• Stay current on sourcing techniques, interview innovation, and AI/ML talent-market trends; bring new approaches back to the team.

• 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience supporting technical research teams, with a track record of recruiting AI/ML research talent specifically.

• Strong existing network in the ML research community (NeurIPS, ICML, top CS/ML programs).

• Proven ability to attract passive candidates from leading academic institutions and frontier labs, and to scale a high-performing technical hiring function.

• Strong technical aptitude - comfortable understanding and evaluating ML/research qualifications alongside hiring managers.

• Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills with senior technical leaders.

• Comfortable operating with autonomy and juggling shifting priorities in a fast-moving environment.

• Deep interest in AI's potential and a realistic view of its risks and limitations - genuine enthusiasm for Lila's scientific mission.

• Hands-on experience with agentic recruiting tools/workflows (automations, enrichment/triage helpers) to improve candidate discovery.

Make a difference. Be happy. Grow your career.
The Role
​​ The Application Analyst I provides frontline support for clinical and business applications within the Managed Services division of Nordic Global . This role is ideal for recent entrants to the healthcare IT industry who have gained applications certifications or preliminary experience. The Application Analyst is responsible for responding to application support requests, managing documentation, collaborating with vendors and team members, and continuing their ongoing growth within healthcare IT.

Nordic, repeat Best in KLAS IT Services Firm and solely serving the healthcare industry, strives to empower healthcare providers to leverage technology and to realize digital transformation. All Nordic staff embrace Nordic’s maxims and mission to serve our customers who care so well f or us.

Key Responsibilities

• Achieve necessary certifications and follow learning paths to ensure ongoing growth.

• Respond to application support requests and incidents within defined SLAs, ensuring excellent customer service and communication.

• Manage application and team documentation, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and relevancy.

• Establish and maintain relationships with software vendors to ensure high-level support.

• Assist in planning and executing application upgrades and security patches.

• Participate in smaller analyst-led projects, learning basic project management tasks such as scheduling meetings and taking meeting minutes.

• Learn clinically integrated hospital and physician office workflows (both clinical and business).

• Comply with all written team policies and procedures.

• Learn and leverage existing details of application documentation to provide effective and informed application support.

• Understand the entire application lifecycle to include implementations, upgrades, and eventual decommissioning and data archiving.

• Advance application knowledge and understanding from mentor/lead during first 12 months.

Skills and Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Healthcare Informatics, Computer Sciences, or a related field (relevant education and/or 6+ years’ industry experience).

• 3+ years’ experience in healthcare IT or equivalent IT application analyst position with degree requirement.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent communication and customer service abilities.

• Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.

Additional details

• Some roles may require participation in an on-call rotation to provide 24x7 support for critical applications, ensuring continuous and reliable service availability and travel as necessary to support the business.
Nordic is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital or veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable federal, state, or local laws. We encourage individuals of all backgrounds to apply, including women, minorities, individuals with disabilities, and veterans.

title: Director, Advancement
description:
Title: Director, Advancement

Department: Advancement

Status: Exempt

Reports To: Vice President of Advancement

Remote position, Preference given to New York City and/or Metro

Summary

The Director, Advancement is a key member of the National Psoriasis Foundation ’s Advancement team, responsible for building and growing relationships with individual donors and prospects to expand philanthropic support for NPF’s mission. This position manages a portfolio across annual, major, and planned giving, with a strong emphasis on developing meaningful donor relationships, securing significant philanthropic commitments, and building a robust pipeline for future growth.

The Director combines frontline fundraising with strategic planning and collaboration, working closely with Advancement leadership, executive leadership, board members, health care professionals, volunteers, and colleagues across NPF to connect donors with the programs, research, and priorities that are most meaningful to them.

As NPF prepares for a future capital campaign and seeks to significantly expand philanthropic investment in its mission, the Director will play an important role in strengthening donor relationships, developing the philanthropic pipeline, and advancing the fundraising practices and infrastructure needed to achieve ambitious organizational goals.

Portfolio Management & Relationship Building

• Manage and grow a portfolio of individual donors and prospects across annual, major, and planned giving.

• Identify and qualify prospective donors with the capacity, inclination, and connection to make meaningful philanthropic investments in NPF.

• Build strong, personalized relationships by understanding each donor’s connection to NPF, philanthropic interests, and motivations for giving.

• Conduct meaningful donor visits, virtual meetings, and personalized outreach to deepen engagement and advance relationships.

• Develop and execute strategic moves management plans that guide donors and prospects through cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.

• Build and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified prospects to achieve current revenue goals and support long-term individual giving growth.

Major & Planned Giving

• Cultivate, solicit, and secure significant philanthropic commitments from individuals and families, including five-, six-, and seven-figure gifts, as appropriate.

• Partner with the Vice President of Advancement, Chief Development Officer, CEO, board members, health care professionals, and volunteers to develop and execute strategies for key donors and prospects.

• Identify and promote planned and legacy giving opportunities, including bequests, beneficiary designations, charitable gift annuities, and other appropriate giving vehicles.

• Leverage NPF events, programs, and mission experiences as strategic opportunities to cultivate relationships, advance solicitations, and deepen donor engagement.

• Develop compelling giving opportunities that connect donor interests with NPF’s mission, programs, research, and strategic priorities.

• Support NPF special events through strategic donor and honoree engagement, particularly when honorees, event leaders, or key participants are part of the Director’s portfolio or donor relationships.

Donor Engagement & Stewardship

• Develop personalized stewardship strategies that demonstrate impact, strengthen donor relationships, and inspire continued and increased philanthropic support.

• Collaborate with Research, Advocacy, Patient Support, Marketing, and other teams to create meaningful opportunities for donors to experience and understand the impact of NPF’s work.

• Connect donors with NPF leadership, researchers, health care professionals, programs, and volunteer leaders based on their interests and engagement goals.

• Ensure timely and appropriate donor recognition, impact reporting, and stewardship for portfolio donors and prospects.

• Serve as a collaborative partner across the Advancement

title: Fractional Game Producer
description:
Job Summary
Exient is seeking an experienced and highly organised Fractional Game Producer to support our team on a remote, contract basis. We're ideally looking for someone based in the UK. In this role, you will manage game development projects across their lifecycle, from planning and production through to release and live operations, on a part-time basis of 20-25 hours per week. You'll work closely with our Malta-based cross-functional teams, including product, design, engineering, and art, to make sure projects are delivered on time, on budget, and to the highest quality.
This is a great opportunity for a seasoned producer who enjoys variety, works independently, and can make an immediate impact. You'll bring structure and momentum to our projects, building strong relationships internally and with our external partners, while keeping the flexibility of a contractor arrangement.
Responsibilities Include

• Oversee the delivery of assigned internal and external projects through development, release, and live operations

• Quickly get up to speed on existing projects and processes, and work effectively within an agreed time allocation

• Collaborate with teams to create realistic and achievable project plans

• Identify and proactively solve risks, blockers and dependencies ahead of time

• Maintain clear and accurate project reporting for leadership and stakeholders

• Ensure deliverables meet agreed quality standards and client expectations

• Build and maintain strong working relationships across the business and with external partners

• Represent the Production team positively within the studio and with clients

• Document processes and decisions clearly so work continues smoothly on non-working days

• Be flexible to adjust focus as priorities evolve within the agreed scope

Education and Experience

• 3+ years of experience in game development production or project management within the agile framework

• Proven ability to work autonomously and deliver results on a part-time or contract basis

• Hands-on experience with resource planning, sprint organisation, JIRA and risk mitigation is essential

• Scrum Master certification is a plus

• Previous freelance, fractional or consulting experience is a plus

Technical Skills

• An understanding of the game development pipeline from concept to live

• The ability to communicate with all game-related disciplines is essential

• Proficiency in JIRA and Confluence

• Knowledge of Apple App Store and Google Play Store release pipelines

• The ability to work in an iterative and agile production process

• Interest in video games and the game development process

• Experience introducing or managing AI-assisted development workflows and agentic toolchains is a plus

AI & Development Tools
We use AI to support and accelerate our internal development processes, including assisting with workflows, reviewing code, identifying bugs and improving productivity across the studio.
We are particularly interested in speaking with producers who have practical experience using AI within game development, including establishing AI-assisted workflows, pipelines and toolchains, and exploring the use of agentic AI to automate or streamline development and production processes.
We do not currently use generative AI to create game artwork.
Interpersonal Skills

• Fluent in English

• Self-directed, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability

• Excellent communication skills, including clear written updates and handovers

• Comfortable working remotely and collaborating with a distributed team across time zones

• Calm under pressure, with a solution-oriented mindset

• Ability to navigate conflicts constructively and maintain team morale under pressure

• Strong people leadership skills, with an understanding of how to motivate teams, recognise individual contributions and ensure people feel valued and supported.

title: Finance Graduate 2027
description:
Looking to kickstart your career and make a global impact? Join Ocado Group’s Graduate Programme and become a driving force in the future of technology.

Programme Overview

• Start Date: Early September 2027

• Duration of Programme: 3 years (Fixed-term, full-time)

• Location: Hatfield, Hertfordshire (hybrid)

About Us

Ocado Group delivers innovative technology solutions powered by the latest advancements in automation, robotics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence, catering to the online grocery and non-grocery distribution sectors. 
With over 20 years of experience in the online grocery industry and a portfolio of patented technologies, we strive to transform the economics and service standards of grocery ecommerce on a global scale
A workplace culture that celebrates diversity, collaboration, and creativity.
Discover more about Ocado Group’s story here. 

About the Role

Join our competitive 3 year rotational programme starting in September 2027 and build the skills to become a future finance leader at a global technology pioneer. You will complete three 1 year placements across core areas including Commercial Finance, FP&A, Logistics, and Group Finance while receiving full study support, dedicated exam time off, and sponsorship to earn your professional accounting qualification. Working alongside senior finance professionals, you will gain hands-on exposure to core accounting and strategic business partnering, positioning you to transition into key Finance Analyst or Accountant roles upon qualification.

About You

• Holds (or is on track to achieve) a bachelor's degree in any subject from any university.

• Curious, commercially minded, and resilient with the adaptability to thrive in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment.

• An interest in working with numbers, solving problems, and spotting patterns or trends.

• Strong communication skills with the confidence to build relationships and explain ideas clearly to stakeholders.

Note: This role does not qualify for Skilled Worker Sponsorship and requires full right to work in the UK for the full duration of the programme.

Application Process

• Online Application: Share your background and client-facing career ambitions.

• Online Tests: Demonstrate your numerical and problem-solving abilities.

• Video Interview: Introduce yourself and showcase your communication skills.

• Assessment Centre: Collaborate with peers on real-world scenarios.

What We Offer

We believe in supporting our people with meaningful, flexible benefits that prioritise well-being and work-life balance. Here's a snapshot of what you can expect:

• Time to recharge: 25 days annual leave (rising to 27 after 5 years), plus the option to buy more - and 30 days a year to work from anywhere in the world.

• Health & wellbeing: Private Medical Insurance from your first month, wellbeing support through specialist apps and EAP, plus Income Protection and Life Assurance.

• Family-first policies: 22 weeks paid maternity/primary carer leave and 6 weeks paid paternity leave.

• Financial support: Pension with employer matching up to 7%, share schemes (Sharesave & BAYE), and interest-free loans for train tickets.

• Commuter perks: Cycle to Work Scheme and free shuttle buses to/from Hatfield and Welwyn Garden City stations.

• Exclusive discounts: 15% off at Ocado.com with free delivery (starting in your first month).

Ocado Group is an equal opportunities employer and as such makes every effort to ensure that all potential employees are treated fairly and equally, regardless of their sex, sexual orientation, marital status, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, age, or disability or union membership status.

title: FinTech Operations Graduate (Customer Support)

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is an entry-level role for someone who wants to start a career in operations at a financial services firm. You'll join our UK Customer Operations team and train to become a fully competent front-line agent, supporting customers across our personal loans, credit cards and car finance. That covers everything from general service queries to more intricate financial support situations. By taking ownership of every enquiry from first contact to final resolution, you will not only deliver exceptional customer outcomes but also provide actionable feedback and insights to help improve our automated tools and AI-driven customer journeys

You'll be based in our Chatham office three days a week and work two weekend days a month (one Saturday and one Sunday), with a day in lieu the week before so you never work more than five days in a week.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Resolving general customer service and financial support queries across any one of our products in either loans, cards or car finance over multiple channels, following established processes

- Owning each enquiry from first contact to resolution, or escalating it to the right place when it needs to go further

- Supporting customers in financial difficulty or in vulnerable situations: listening actively, asking the right questions to understand their circumstances, and finding the right support option for them

- Keeping conversations on track while building rapport and trust, so every outcome is both positive for the customer and compliant

- Meeting your targets for customer satisfaction, quality and compliance by following procedures carefully and using judgement where a customer's situation calls for it, and logging every interaction accurately for audit and learning

- Using AI and digital tools to resolve queries faster and more accurately

- Feeding back blockers, process gaps and recurring issues to the relevant teams, and taking part in process reviews that improve our knowledge base, training resources and AI systems

- Keeping up with product, system and process changes, acting on coaching and feedback, and sharing what you learn with colleagues

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Essential

- Clear, empathetic communication, both spoken and written. You can adapt to the person in front of you and explain something complicated in plain English

- The ability to learn quickly, pick up new products and procedures, and act on coaching

- Good organisation: you can manage several tasks at once and follow a structured process accurately

- Sound judgemen

title: Finance Analytics Engineer | FP&A
description:
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Do you like knowing exactly why a number moved? As an Finance Analytics Engineer at ARQ, you'll own the data foundations behind our revenue, cost and management reporting. You'll sit between Finance and Engineering: building the models that tell us how the business is performing, keeping them accurate every day, and turning them into insight that leadership uses to make decisions.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is as comfortable in a dbt project or a Python codebase as in a P&L. You'll work closely with Finance, Treasury and Engineering, and your work will feed management, investor and regulatory reporting directly.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Own the finance data layer: Maintain and extend our dbt repo. That means building and refactoring models, writing tests, and keeping finance data clean, documented and reliable.

- Revenue and cost models: Build and maintain the models behind revenue, unit economics and operations costs (payment rails, FX, card, banking partners, vendors) across our markets.

- Management accounts: Support daily and monthly management accounts on both accrual and cash basis. Reconcile them to source systems and explain movements.

- Budgeting and forecasting: Feed actuals into the budget and forecast, run variance analysis, and help Finance understand what is driving performance.

- Python services: Help maintain and improve the internal Python services and pipelines that support finance reporting and reconciliation.

- Data mapping and requirements: Map data sources across our product and payments stack, and document business logic and assumptions so others can trust and reuse your work.

- Onboard new business: When we launch a new product, partner or market, make sure it flows correctly into financial reporting, controls and processes.

- Dashboards and reporting: Build and improve dashboards with Finance and Controllership that track key metrics and surface business drivers.

- Anomalies and controls: Spot breaks, unusual spikes or data quality issues early, find the root cause, and fix it at the source.

- Data literacy: Help the wider team understand and self-serve finance data.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- 3+ years in a data, analytics or FP&A role, ideally in fintech, banking or payments

- Strong SQL and solid Python

- Hands-on experience with dbt (or a similar transformation tool) and version control (Git)

- A good grasp of financial statements, management accounts and core finance concepts (accruals, revenue recognition, unit economics)

- A quantitative background, through education or experience

- Strong attention to detail and a quality-first mindset, while still able to work to tight deadlines

- Clear communication: you can explain a variance to a CFO and a data model to an engineer

- Initiative to automate repetitive work and improve how things are done

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with regulatory or external reporting

- Exposure to reconciliations, treasury or general ledger data

- Experience with BI tools (Metabase, Looker, Power BI) and orchestration tools (Airflow or similar)

- Experience maintaining production code: code review, testing, CI/CD

- Spanish or Portuguese proficiency

BENEFITS

- Competitive salary and benefits

- Stock options, so you own part of what you build

- Discretionary performance bonus

- The latest tools and technology

- A world-class team that will challenge and grow your skills

- The opportunity to help build the best fintech app in Latin America

- Office Policy: 3-4 days a week in-office

title: Quality Monitoring Analyst
description:
The Quality Monitoring Analyst (QMA) is responsible for the overall call quality monitoring program across US Customer Care (USCC). This includes facilitating alignment and continuous improvement across Customer Care. The QMA will work closely with managers in each department to prepare them to deliver specific and actionable feedback at the individual, group, and department levels. The QMA will track and trend results at a micro and macro level, and work with managers to develop training and support materials to assist colleagues in their customer obsessed continuous improvement journey. The QMA will exhibit `One Zoetis ' behaviors by working adjacent with the Customer Experience Team to foster and celebrate exceptional customer interactions. The QMA will serve as primary administrator of the QM platform for all supported teams, working with business and technical partners to ensure reliable data and system performance in support of the overall QM program.

Position Responsibilities :

• Maintain with continuous improvement a quality monitoring program for all relevant contact centers, aligning/maintaining quality standards and scoring across teams and providing visual representation via QM dashboards for both managers and agents. Relevant departments include Veterinary Customer Service, Field Force Customer Service, VMIPS, Dx Tech Support, Zoetis Reference Labs, Dx Customer Service and Zoetis Petcare Rewards.

• Partner with Customer Experience and Technology team to evaluate and enhance customer interactions with Zoetis through the implementation of technology solutions that will help drive actionable results.

• Help establish best practices and standards around categorization, sentiment, and practical insight analysis principles.

• Administer QM platform in areas related to user setup/maintenance and dashboard modification based on colleague feedback.

• Use the existing Quality Management (QM) platform to identify trends in customer contact drivers, translate findings into actions that reduce customer pain points, and build ad hoc dashboards as needed to communicate insights.

• Communicate regularly with managers of relevant teams to calibrate call expectations and establish key messages/guidance for coaching opportunities.

• Collaborate with others to bring relevant Customer Care metrics into the QM platform and maintain executive level reporting to generate insights for stakeholders.

• Provide new hire and refresher trainings for agents and managers using the QM dashboards.

Education and Experience:

• Bachelor's degree required

• Minimum 3 years of customer service experience, preferably in a contact center environment

• Previous experience with a quality monitoring, quality assurance, or contact center performance program preferred

• Experience supporting process improvement initiatives and translating insights into actionable recommendations

title: Chargé(e) de comptes - restauration
description:
Bonjour ! Merci de votre visite 👋

Vous êtes activement à la recherche d'une nouvelle opportunité ? Ou vous souhaitez simplement vous renseigner sur le marché ? Eh bien... vous êtes peut-être au bon endroit !

Lightspeed est à la recherche d’un(e) Chargé(e) de comptes pour rejoindre notre équipe de vente Hospitality. Idéalement, tu seras basé(e) à Toronto ou à Montréal, où tu collaboreras étroitement avec ton équipe dans un environnement de travail hybride et flexible.

Dans ce rôle, tu aideras des restaurants à travers l’Amérique du Nord à découvrir comment Lightspeed peut soutenir et faire croître leur entreprise.

Tu travailleras principalement avec des prospects entrants qualifiés, en réalisant des démonstrations du produit, en comprenant les besoins opérationnels des restaurateurs et en les accompagnant tout au long du cycle de vente.

C’est une excellente opportunité pour un(e) chargé(e) de comptes en début de carrière dans le SaaS qui aime mener des démonstrations, évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et aider les entreprises à adopter des technologies qui améliorent leurs opérations.

Si tu es passionné(e) par la vente, la technologie et l’accompagnement d’entrepreneurs dans le secteur de la restauration, ce rôle pourrait être parfait pour toi.

Ce que vous allez faire :

- Gérer et assurer le suivi de prospects entrants qualifiés générés par les équipes marketing et SDR

- Réaliser des démonstrations produit par visioconférence et partage d’écran auprès de restaurateurs

- Comprendre les besoins opérationnels des clients et recommander la solution Lightspeed la plus adaptée

- Accompagner les prospects tout au long du cycle de vente, de la démonstration jusqu’à la signature

- Collaborer étroitement avec les Sales Development Representatives (SDR) pour coordonner les démonstrations et les opportunités

- Travailler avec les équipes internes sur les négociations et la structuration des offres lorsque nécessaire

- Atteindre et dépasser les objectifs de vente mensuels et trimestriels

- Accompagner les nouveaux clients durant les premières étapes d’implantation et de mise en service

Ce que vous devez apporter :

- 2 à 4 ans d’expérience en vente, idéalement dans un environnement SaaS ou technologique

- Expérience dans la réalisation de démonstrations produit ou de ventes consultatives

- Excellentes compétences en communication et en présentation

- Capacité à gérer plusieurs opportunités dans un environnement de vente dynamique et à volume élevé

- Un fort sens des responsabilités et de l’autonomie

- Curiosité et volonté d’apprendre et de progresser continuellement

- Excellente maîtrise de l’anglais à l’oral et à l’écrit

- En tant qu’entreprise mondiale comptant des employés et des clients à l’extérieur du Québec, la maîtrise de l’anglais comme langue de travail est requise pour ce poste.

Et un peu de...

- Expérience dans la vente de solutions SaaS ou logicielles

- Expérience avec des clients SMB (petites et moyennes entreprises)

- Expérience dans le secteur de la restauration ou de l’hospitalité

- Connaissance des systèmes POS, paiements ou logiciels de gestion d’entreprise

- Expérience avec Salesforce ou un CRM similaire

title: Packaging Manager
description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company - powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit  WPP.com .

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around 3 days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What does a Packaging Program Manager do at Hogarth?  
  The Packaging Program Manager assists Packaging Producers in organizing documentation, reviewing accuracy of packaging mechanicals, organizing color and press sheet reviews, and helping the team meet tight deadlines in peak seasons. You will manage deliverable due dates according to established standards and timelines, while also coming up with creative solutions to challenges.

Responsibilities

• Write print specification documents in the database-with the direction of the Packaging Producers-prior to handing off to Production Design. Ensure all documents have been approved by the Packaging Producers before releasing to suppliers.

• QC and organize assets in the database for each mechanical (part numbers, packaging die-lines, translations, illustrations, copy, etc.).

• Manage project life cycles and the release of part numbers.

• Prepare asset handoff documents for review by Packaging Producers and route to Marcom groups.

• Practice extreme attention to detail in cross-referencing all assets against the final mechanicals per checklist, and confirming all layers match print specifications.

• Communicate updates collected from Packaging Producers to Marcom Project Management team to facilitate the routing process.

• Provide complete and timely feedback on digital mechanicals, pre-press, and printer proofs.

• Review and sign off on supplier PDFs and press sheets and raise any issues when appropriate.

• Organize final reviews with Packaging Producers.

• Collaborate with Packaging team to document best practices and standard operating procedures and processes for both internal and external partners.

• Press check print runs for existing products at domestic and international suppliers and prepare for Producer approval.

Qualifications/Requirements

• BA/BS degree in Graphic Communications or equivalent.

• 2-5 years mechanical proofing experience in premium consumer packaging and labeling.

• Knowledge of electronic pre-press and printing processes required.

• Project management experience preferred.

• Must possess exceptional organizational, time management, verbal, and written communication skills, interpersonal skills, and the ability to prioritize.

• Proficient in Adobe Creative Cloud: Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, Adobe Acrobat.

• Proficient in Mac OS and native apps.

This is a contract role.
